data.narrative:
Galadyne is a pre-seed stage defense & security company founded by Chandler Luzsicza that has raised $4.8M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 10 private and public peers in the Defense & Security sector, including private companies such as Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI, as well as public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS).

Of the two valuation methods assessed, only stage-progression analysis proved applicable. The peer-median approach could not be executed due to insufficient narrow-filter peers—while 21 companies operate in the Defense & Security sector broadly, fewer than three met simultaneous criteria of same stage, adjacent stage, or similar valuation tier. Stage-progression applied a 2.5x step-up multiplier to the $4.8M total raised proxy, reflecting typical pre-seed to next-stage advancement, yielding an implied valuation of $12M.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $10M to $14M, with a median of $12M. However, this estimate carries meaningful uncertainty: it derives from a single applicable method rather than multiple independent approaches. The analysis would benefit from additional same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables in the defense tech space to strengthen conviction through peer triangulation. Key assumptions underlying the stage-progression multiple should be tested against actual outcomes of recent pre-seed to seed financings within this sector.
